.decl parent(child:number, par:number)
.input parent
.decl person(x:number)
.input person
.decl sg(x:number, y:number)
.decl notsg(x:number, y:number)
.decl q_notsg(y:number)
.output q_notsg
sg(x, x) :- person(x).
sg(x, y) :- parent(x, xp), parent(y, yp), sg(xp, yp), x != y.
notsg(x, y) :- person(x), person(y), !sg(x, y).
q_notsg(y) :- notsg(0, y).
